newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan court dismisses libel case against minister.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan court dismisses libel case against minister.

text.p: Morocco's supreme court has ruled against hearing a libel action brought by a Member of Parliament against Privatisation Minister Abderrahmane Saaidi, the official Moroccan news agency MAP said on Thursday.

It said the court late on Wednesday discharged the minister from the action brought against him by Miloud Chaabi, businessman and an opposition MP, who had accused Saaidi of "defamation by way of the press".
The plaintif went to court after an interview with the minister appeared in the Casablanca-based weekly l'Economiste newspaper on the privatisation programme in which the MP was criticised.
Defence lawyers said the minister's statement were aimed at the "general interest and not at defaming the plaintif".
